Business rules:
- All queries are read-only. Never generate INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE, MERGE, CREATE, or GRANT.
- Revenue is stored net of discount in FACT_SALES.revenue.
- Join facts to dimensions on surrogate keys (date_id, customer_id, product_id, region_id).
- Always add a LIMIT to exploratory row-level queries unless an aggregate is requested.
- Time comparisons use DIM_DATE.year / quarter / month.
Metric definitions:
- gross_margin: Net revenue minus total cost. (SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost))
- gross_margin_pct: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue. ((SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100)
- yoy_growth: Year-over-year revenue growth percent comparing a period to the same period one year earlier. ((current_period_revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0) * 100)
- total_revenue: Sum of net revenue. (SUM(revenue))
- units_sold: Total quantity of units sold. (SUM(quantity))
- average_discount: Mean discount fraction applied across sales lines. (AVG(discount_pct))
- forecast_attainment: Actual revenue divided by forecasted revenue. (SUM(FACT_SALES.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(FACT_FORECAST.forecast_revenue), 0) * 100)
- on_time_delivery_rate: Share of shipments delivered on time. (AVG(CASE WHEN on_time_flag THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100)
